title: 第9章 金风野店
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苏亦川技艺得自名门真传，虽危不乱，激斗之中，忽骈左手两指，直向冯国栋乳下穴道点去。冯国栋急退两步。苏亦川两指变掌，在拉赫蒙脸前虚显一下，待对方举刀挡格，手掌故意迟迟缩回。拉赫蒙看出有便宜可占，鬼头刀变守为攻，直削过去。苏亦川左掌将敌人武器诱过，金笛横击，正中敌腰。拉赫蒙大哼一声，痛得蹲了下去。苏亦川待要赶打，冯国栋迎剑架住。冯辉一阵弹子，又把他挡住。

拉赫蒙顺了一口气，强忍痛楚，咬紧牙关，站起来溜到苏亦川背后，乘他前顾长剑、侧避弹子之际，用**生之力，鬼头刀使一招“独劈华山”向他后脑砍去，这招攻其无备，实难躲避。哪知刀锋堪堪砍到敌人顶心，腕上突然奇痛，武器拿捏不住，跌落在地，呆得一呆，胸口又中了一柄飞刀，当场气绝。

苏亦川回过头来，只见王怡丹左手扶桌，站在身后，右手拿着一柄飞刀，纤指执白刃，如持鲜花枝，俊目流眄，樱唇含笑，举手毙敌，浑若无事，说不尽的妩媚可喜。他一见之下，胸口一热，精神大振，金笛舞起一团黄光，大叫：“丹姊，把打弹弓的鹰爪子废了！”

王怡丹微微一笑，飞刀出手。冯辉听到叫声，忙转身迎敌，只见明晃晃的一把柳叶尖刀已迎胸飞来，风劲势急，忙举弹弓挡架，啪的一声，弓脊立断，飞刀余势未衰，又将他手背削破。冯辉大骇，狂叫：“师叔，风紧扯呼！”转身就走，冯国栋唰唰两剑，把苏亦川逼退两步，将软倒在地的金诺维奇背起，冯辉挥鞭断后，冲向店门。

苏亦川见警官逃走，也不追赶，将金笛举到嘴边。崔莹心想这人真是好整以暇，这当口还吹笛呢。谁知他这次并非横吹，而是像吹洞箫般直吹，只见他一鼓气，一支小箭从金笛中飞出来。冯辉头一低，小箭钉在金诺维奇臀上，痛得他哇哇大叫。

苏亦川转身问：“雷哥呢？”王怡丹说：“跟我来。”她腿上受伤，撑了根拖把当拐杖，引路进房。苏亦川从地下拾起一把飞刀交还王怡丹，问道：“丹姊怎么受的伤，不碍事么？”

那边冯国栋背了金诺维奇蹿出，生怕敌人追来，使足了劲往店门奔去，刚出门口，外面进来一人，登时撞个满怀。冯国栋数十年功夫，下盘扎得坚实异常，哪知被进来这人轻轻一碰，竟收不住脚，连连退出几步，把金诺维奇脱手抛在地上，才没跌倒。

这下金诺维奇可惨了，那支小箭在地上一撞，连箭羽没入肉里。

冯国栋一抬头，见进来的是蔡锦昂，转怒为喜，将已到嘴边的一句粗话缩回肚里，忙请了个安，说道：“蔡处长，我们不中用，一个兄弟让点子废了，这个又给点了穴道。”蔡锦昂哦了一声，左手一把将金诺维奇提起，右手在他腰里一捏，腿上一拍，就把他闭住的血脉解开了，问道：“点子跑了吗？”冯国栋说：“还在店里呢。”蔡锦昂“哼”了声说：“胆子倒不小，袭警拒捕，还敢大模大样地住店。”一边说话，一边走进院子。

冯辉一指雷盖的店房，说道：“蔡处长，点子在那里！”手持软鞭，当先开路。

Page (1/3)

Su Yichuan's skills were obtained from the true teachings of famous sects. Although he was in danger, he suddenly moved two fingers of his left hand directly towards the acupoints under Feng Guodong's breasts during the fierce fight.Feng Guodong took two quick steps back.Su Yichuan turned his two fingers into palms and showed them in front of Rahmon's face. When the opponent raised his knife to block, he deliberately retracted his palms slowly.Rahmon saw that there was an advantage to be taken, and the Ghost Head Saber turned from defense to offense and cut straight through.Su Yichuan used his left palm to lure the enemy's weapon past, and struck the enemy with the golden flute in the middle.Rahmon groaned loudly and squatted down in pain.Su Yichuan was about to fight, but Feng Guodong stopped him with his sword.Feng Hui blocked him again after a flurry of bullets.

Rahmon breathed a sigh of relief, endured the pain, gritted his teeth, stood up and sneaked behind Su Yichuan. While Su Yichuan was looking forward to his long sword and avoiding the bullets, he used the force of his body to slash the back of his head with the "Single Splitting Huashan" move from the Ghost Head Sword. He was unprepared for this move and it was really difficult to avoid it.Unexpectedly, the blade barely hit the enemy's heart, and there was a sudden pain in his wrist. He couldn't hold the weapon, and he fell to the ground. He was stunned for a moment. Another flying knife hit his chest, and he died on the spot.

Su Yichuan turned around and saw Wang Yidan holding the table with his left hand, standing behind him, holding a flying knife in his right hand, with a white blade in his slender fingers, like a branch of flowers, his handsome eyes were shining, his lips were smiling, and he raised his hand to kill the enemy, as if nothing had happened. He was indescribably charming and gratifying.When he saw it, his chest felt hot and his spirit was greatly boosted. The golden flute danced with a ball of yellow light and shouted: "Sister Dan, destroy the eagle's talons that are used to shoot the slingshot!"

Wang Yidan smiled slightly and took action with the flying knife.Feng Hui heard the cry and turned around to face the enemy. He saw a bright willow-leaf knife flying toward his chest. The wind was strong and he quickly raised his slingshot to block the attack. With a snap, the bow spine broke immediately. The flying knife still had its force and sliced ​​the back of his hand.Feng Hui was horrified and yelled: "Uncle, the wind is blowing hard!" He turned around and left. Feng Guodong swung his sword twice, forcing Su Yichuan to take two steps back. He picked up Jinovich, who was lying on the ground, and Feng Hui broke his whip and rushed to the store door.

When Su Yichuan saw the police officer running away, he did not pursue him and raised the golden flute to his mouth.Cui Ying thought to herself that this person really had a lot of leisure time, and he was still playing the flute at this moment.Unexpectedly, he did not blow horizontally this time, but straightly like a hole flute. When he puffed up, a small arrow flew out of the golden flute.Feng Hui lowered his head, and the small arrow hit Jinovich's butt, causing him to scream in pain.

Su Yichuan turned around and asked, "Where is Brother Lei?" Wang Yidan said, "Follow me." She injured her leg and used a mop as a crutch to lead the way into the room.Su Yichuan picked up a throwing knife from the ground and handed it back to Wang Yidan and asked, "How did Sister Dan get injured? Is it okay?"

Over there, Feng Guodong carried Jinovich on his back and jumped out. He was afraid that the enemy would chase him, so he ran with all his strength to the door of the store. As soon as he left the door, a person came in from outside, and he was immediately bumped into.Feng Guodong had worked hard for decades, and his lower body was extremely solid. Unexpectedly, he was touched lightly by the man who came in, and he couldn't stop his footing. He took a few steps back and threw Jinovich's hand to the ground, so that he didn't fall.

This time Jinovich was miserable. The small arrow hit the ground and even the feathers of the arrow sank into his flesh.

Feng Guodong raised his head and saw Cai Jinang coming in. His anger turned into joy. He retracted the curse word that had come to his lips, and hurriedly said goodbye, "Director Cai, we are of no use. One brother let the idea go to waste, and this one opened the acupoint again." Cai Jinang said oh, and lifted Jinovich up with his left hand., pinched his waist with his right hand, and patted his leg to untie his closed blood vessels, and asked: "Did the idea escape?" Feng Guodong said: "It's still in the store." Cai Jinang said with a "humph": "You are very courageous. You attacked the police and resisted arrest, and you dared to stay in the store in a big way." While talking, he walked into the yard.

Feng Hui pointed at Lei Gai's shop and said, "Director Cai, where's the idea?" He held a soft whip and was the first to clear the way.
